info.title: PAY API
info.description:
API Encryption Rules

Key Pair Generation Method

Due to the various formats of RSA keys, the payment system currently supports only PKCS8 key pairs with a length of 2048. The key formats obtained from different channels may not be the same, and may not meet the key pair requirements of the payment system. In order to ensure that all merchants can obtain key pairs that can be used in the payment system, we provide the following way to obtain key pairs. Merchants can use the following commands on Mac/Linux using OpenSSL to generate available key pairs:
Private key generation:

openssl genpkey -out rsa_private_key.pem -outform PEM -algorithm RSA -pkeyopt rsa_keygen_bits:2048

Public key generation:

openssl rsa -in rsa_private_key.pem -pubout -out rsa_public_key.pem

Encryption Rules

To ensure the security of transactions, this system uses an encryption mechanism for all interactive APIs, and this set of encryption rules must be used for all API interactions to ensure the security of partner funds. The encryption rules are as follows:
According to the specific API document, obtain the required request parameter list and form a Map in the form of key-value pairs (key=value).
The calculation process of the 'sign' parameter is as follows:
a. Sort the key-value pairs in Map1 by key in ascending order according to ASCII code to generate the key-value pairs Map2.
b. Connect the ordered parameter key-value pairs in Map2 with '&' to form String1.
c. Append the secret key to the end of String1 to generate String2.
d. Sign String2 with your private key using the SHA256withRSA algorithm and then Base64 encode it (no need for UrlSafe Base64 at this time). This value is the value of the 'sign' parameter.
e. Insert the generated 'sign' as a key-value pair <sign,'xxxxx'> into the request parameter Map. This completes the encapsulation of the request parameters.
For GET requests, connect the request parameters with '&' and then Base64 encode the concatenated result using URL-safe Base64 to generate the 'param' parameter. Finally, use the 'param' parameter to initiate a request to the payment system API:
GET https://domain.com/apidemo?param=xxxxxxx
For POST requests, use the Map parameters that have been encapsulated as a JSON format for the Post body and initiate the Post request directly.

Here is an example

Assuming that an API requires the following parameters:

Parameter NameParameter Value
ccc111
aaa22
aab444
eee555
ddd666
AB00

Calculate the signature of the request.

a. Sort the key-value pairs in Map1 in ascending order of ASCII code to generate Map2.

{'aaa':22,'ccc':111,'aab':444,'eee':555,'ddd':666,'AB':00,} // sort in ascending order of ASCII code, note that it is in ascending order of ASCII code. {'AB':00,'aaa':22,'aab':444,'ccc':111,'ddd':666,'eee':555}

b. Concatenate the sorted parameter keys and values in Map2 using the&symbol to generate String1.

{   'AB':00,   'aaa':22,   'aab':444,   'ccc':111,   'ddd':666,   'eee':555}// parameter splicing AB=00&aaa=22&aab=444&ccc=111&ddd=666&eee=555

c. Concatenate the secret key (assumed to be: PslBum8DW0uGEI687X38QpdW53e452zvVVYyzUcT) at the end of String1 to generate String2.

AB=00&aaa=22&aab=444&ccc=111&ddd=666&eee=555 // concatenate secret key AB=00&aaa=22&aab=444&ccc=111&ddd=666&eee=555PslBum8DW0uGEI687X38QpdW53e452zvVVYyzUcT

d. Sign String2 with your private key using the SHA256withRSA algorithm and then Base64 the result to obtain the value of the sign parameter.

// sign the signature and perform SHA256withRSA(AB=00&aaa=22&aab=444&ccc=111&ddd=666&eee=555PslBum8DW0uGEI687X38QpdW53e452zvVVYyzUcT, private_key.pem) // the signed result is 

e. Insert the sign parameter into the request parameter Map.

{'aaa':22,'ccc':111,'aab':444,'eee':555,'ddd':666,'AB':00,'sign':''}

Initiate a GET request.

  • Concatenate key-value pairs in the request parameter map containing 'sign' with the '&' symbol and perform URLsafe_Base64 encoding.
//Perform URL safe Base64URLsafe_Base64(ccc=111&aaa=22&&aab=444&eee=555&ddd=666&AB=00)
  • Initiate a GET request.
GET https://doamin.com/apidemo?
  • Initiate a POST request.
    Directly use the JSON-formatted map parameters as the PostBody.
POST https://doamin.com/apidemoPostBody: {'aaa':22,'ccc':111,'aab':444,'eee':555,'ddd':666,'AB':00,    'sign':''}

Verify the signature of the result returned by the payment system.

All callbacks from the payment system are sent using the POST method.

  1. Parse the data returned by the payment system API, usually in JSON format, and extract the 'code' and 'result' fields from the outermost layer of the JSON. If the 'code' is not 10000 or the 'result' is empty, there is no need to verify the signature.
  2. Parse all key-value pairs in the 'result' field, extract the 'sign' field and save it, and then remove any fields that are marked as not requiring signature verification in the API documentation.
  3. Repeat the steps 1, 2, and 3 of calculating the 'sign' for the request, and use the public key downloaded from the payment system to verify the signature using SHA256withRSA.

post.summary: Collection IPN: partner endpoint that receives the collection (payment received) result
post.description: The system sends an HTTP POST (JSON) to the webhook_url declared by the partner when money has been received for a transaction. Respond with HTTP 2xx to acknowledge. A non-2xx response or a timeout (90s) is treated as failed and retried automatically (up to 4 attempts, 30s apart); it can also be resent from the IPN management page. Verify the sign field with the system public key before trusting the data.

received_amount.description: Amount (VND) credited to the partner after fee.

received_date.description: Time the money was received (Y-m-d H:i:s).

ref_code.description: Reference / order code of the transaction (the VA transaction reference, or the code the partner used when creating the payment).

bank_account_number.description: Receiving account number (the VA number for VA transactions).

bank_total_balance.description: Optional. Balance of the receiving bank account after the transaction, only sent when known.

sign.description: Signature of the result fields. Empty if the partner has no system key.

200.description: OK. Any HTTP 2xx response acknowledges the IPN; the body is ignored.

post.summary: Payout IPN: partner endpoint that receives the withdrawal (payout) result
post.description: The system sends an HTTP POST (JSON) to the webhook_payout_url declared by the partner whenever the status of a withdrawal request changes. PENDING is not final; only SUCCESS and FAILED are final. Respond with HTTP 2xx to acknowledge. A non-2xx response or a timeout (90s) is treated as failed and retried automatically (up to 4 attempts, 30s apart); it can also be resent from the IPN management page. Verify the sign field with the system public key before trusting the data.

trans_code.description: Transaction code of the withdrawal generated by the system.

ref_code.description: Reference code sent by the partner when creating the withdrawal request. Empty if none was sent.

content.description: Transfer content (the remark sent when creating the request).

status_id.description: Withdrawal status. 1: requested, 4: processing, 5: awaiting transaction verification, 2: completed, 3: cancelled / failed (amount and fee refunded).

code.description: Result code. PENDING: status_id 1, 4, 5 (not final). SUCCESS: status_id 2. FAILED: status_id 3.

message.description: Note of the withdrawal, e.g. the failure reason.

sign.description: Signature of the result fields. Empty if the partner has no system key.

200.description: OK. Any HTTP 2xx response acknowledges the IPN; the body is ignored.

post.summary: Look up bank account holder name
post.description: Returns the account holder name of a bank account from the bank (bank_id or bank_code) and account number. Use it to verify the recipient before creating a withdrawal request. Set gateway_account_id to look up through a specific GpayV2 gateway account; otherwise the system default gateway is used.

bank_id.description: Bank ID from the bank list API (/api/bank/get-list). Either bank_id or bank_code is required. When bank_id is sent, the bank code is taken from it and bank_code is ignored.

bank_code.description: Bank code (e.g. MB, BIDV, TCB, VCB). Required when bank_id is not sent.

bank_account_number.description: Bank account number to look up.

gateway_account_id.description: Optional. GpayV2 gateway account ID used for the lookup. The system default is used when omitted or invalid.

error_code.description: 0: success. 404: neither bank_id nor bank_code sent, bank_id not found, bank_account_number missing, account holder name not found, or gateway error.

bank_code.description: Bank code that was looked up (resolved from bank_id when bank_id is sent).

bank_account_number.description: Bank account number that was looked up.

errors: Unable to get the account holder name.
Ngân hàng không hợp lệ.

post.description: Returns the paginated list of virtual accounts of the authenticated user. Use the query object to filter and the sort object to order the result. All filters are optional and are combined with AND.

query.description: Filter conditions. Unknown keys are ignored.

bank_short_code.description: Filter by bank code (e.g. MSB, TCB, MB).

status_id.description: Account status. 2: active, 1: inactive (deactivated / under maintenance).

min_amount.description: Exact minimum amount configured on the account.

max_amount.description: Exact maximum amount configured on the account.

sort.description: Sort order, as {column: direction}. Direction is asc or desc. Default is id desc.

error_code.description: 0: success. Other values: error (404 not found / not configured, 414 invalid payload, 401 unauthorized).

bank_account_number.description: Virtual account number. Customers transfer money to this number.

status_id.description: Account status. 2: active, 1: inactive (deactivated / under maintenance).

min_amount.description: Minimum amount (VND) per transaction. null = no limit.

max_amount.description: Maximum amount (VND) per transaction. null = no limit.

order_code.description: Order code generated by the system when the account is created. Use it to update the account.

errors: access_token expired or not allowed

post.description: Creates a virtual account (VA) for the authenticated user. The payment gateway account is resolved from the user's configuration, and the bank must be one of the banks enabled for the user.

bank_code.description: Bank code used to create the VA (e.g. MSB, TCB, MB). It must be one of the banks enabled for your account, otherwise an error is returned.

bank_account_name.description: Account holder name of the VA. It is converted to upper case automatically.

account_type.description: Virtual account type. O: one-time account, closed automatically after receiving a payment. M: multiple-use account, can receive payments repeatedly. Defaults to M when omitted.

min_amount.description: Minimum amount (VND) accepted per transaction. Integer >= 0, must not be greater than max_amount. Omit or set 0 for no limit.

max_amount.description: Maximum amount (VND) accepted per transaction. Integer >= 0, must not be less than min_amount. Omit or set 0 for no limit.

error_code.description: 0: success. Other values: error (404 not found / not configured, 414 invalid payload, 401 unauthorized).

data.description: Response payload. null / empty on error.

user_virtual_account.description: Created virtual account. Use bank_account_number to receive payments.

bank_account_number.description: Virtual account number. Customers transfer money to this number.

status_id.description: Account status. 2: active, 1: inactive (deactivated / under maintenance).

min_amount.description: Minimum amount (VND) per transaction. null = no limit.

max_amount.description: Maximum amount (VND) per transaction. null = no limit.

order_no.description: Reference code of the account on the payment gateway.

order_code.description: Order code generated by the system when the account is created. Use it to update the account.

errors: VA gateway has not been configured for this account.

post.description: Updates the account type (one-time / multiple-use) and the minimum / maximum amount of a virtual account, identified by the order_code returned at creation (the account must belong to the authenticated user). At least one of account_type, min_amount, max_amount is required.

order_code.description: Order code returned when the account was created. The account must belong to the authenticated user.

account_type.description: Virtual account type. O: one-time account, closed automatically after receiving a payment. M: multiple-use account. Omit to keep the current value.

min_amount.description: Minimum amount (VND) accepted per transaction. Integer >= 0, must not be greater than max_amount. Omit to keep the current value.

max_amount.description: Maximum amount (VND) accepted per transaction. Integer >= 0, must not be less than min_amount. Omit to keep the current value.

error_code.description: 0: success. Other values: error (404 not found / not configured, 414 invalid payload, 401 unauthorized).

data.description: Response payload. null / empty on error.

bank_account_number.description: Virtual account number. Customers transfer money to this number.

status_id.description: Account status. 2: active, 1: inactive (deactivated / under maintenance).

min_amount.description: Minimum amount (VND) per transaction. null = no limit.

max_amount.description: Maximum amount (VND) per transaction. null = no limit.

order_no.description: Reference code of the account on the payment gateway.

order_code.description: Order code generated by the system when the account is created. Use it to update the account.

errors: Virtual account not found.

order_code.description: Order code returned when the account was created. The account must belong to the authenticated user.

error_code.description: 0: success. Other values: error (404 not found / not configured, 414 invalid payload, 401 unauthorized).

post.description: Creates a withdrawal request to a bank account. The amount plus fee is deducted from the partner balance immediately. The result (SUCCESS / FAILED) is sent to the partner's webhook_payout_url (see the Payout IPN). Amount must be at least 10,000 VND and below 300,000,000 VND. When 2-factor authentication is enabled on the account, otp is required.

bank_id.description: Recipient bank ID. Get it from the bank list API (/api/bank/get-list).

bank_account_name.description: Recipient account holder name. You can verify it first with /api/other/get-bank-account-name.

amount.description: Amount (VND) to transfer to the recipient, excluding fee. Minimum 10,000.

ref_code.description: Optional. Your own reference code of the request. It is returned in user_withdraw.ref_code and in the Payout IPN (result.ref_code) so you can match the result to your order.

otp.description: Required only when 2-factor authentication is enabled on the account.

error_code.description: 0: success. Other values: error (404 business error such as invalid bank / insufficient balance / limit exceeded, 414 invalid payload, 401 unauthorized).

message.example: Tạo yêu cầu rút tiền thành công.

trans_code.description: Transaction code of the withdrawal generated by the system. Returned in the Payout IPN.

ref_code.description: Your reference code. Empty if not sent.

amount_after_fee.description: Total amount (VND) deducted from the balance (amount + fee).

status_id.description: Withdrawal status. 1: requested, 4: processing, 5: awaiting transaction verification, 2: completed, 3: cancelled / failed.

errors: Số tiền yêu cầu rút tối thiểu 10,000đ.

value.message: Tạo yêu cầu rút tiền thành công.
